Council Meetings

Council Meetings

In accordance with the provisions of Section 277(1) of the Local Government Regulation 2012, notice is given that Ordinary meetings of Council will generally be held on the third Tuesday of each month commencing at 9:30am, in the Council Boardroom, 50 Brolga Street Quilpie, unless otherwise advised or listed in the annual meeting schedule.
